g.desc: 5. R1 holds the SSR off through ESP32 boot and reset. If the SSR LED is dim at 3.3 V,

g.text: 4. U2: on-off heating action, setpoint 600 C; relay closed below setpoint, open unpowered.

g.desc: 4. U2: on-off heating action, setpoint 600 C; relay closed below setpoint, open unpowered.

g.text: 3. Any trip, STOP or power loss drops K1; it stays open until START is pressed.

g.desc: 3. Any trip, STOP or power loss drops K1; it stays open until START is pressed.

g.text: 2. Heaters run only with K1 latched: START pressed, STOP closed, U2 relay closed (T2 < 600 C).

g.desc: 2. Heaters run only with K1 latched: START pressed, STOP closed, U2 relay closed (T2 < 600 C).

g.text: 1. Cord to F1 in 14 AWG; all 120 V wiring after F1 in 16 AWG minimum, rated 105 C.

g.desc: 1. Cord to F1 in 14 AWG; all 120 V wiring after F1 in 16 AWG minimum, rated 105 C.

g.text: 9. PS1 and K1 mount on the DIN rail; layout in enclosure drawing TBK-DWG-005.

g.desc: 9. PS1 and K1 mount on the DIN rail; layout in enclosure drawing TBK-DWG-005.

g.text: 8. T2 goes only to U2, never to the ESP32, so the limit stays independent.

g.desc: 8. T2 goes only to U2, never to the ESP32, so the limit stays independent.

g.text: 7. K1, U1 and U2 terminal numbers are functional; follow each part's wiring label.

g.desc: 7. K1, U1 and U2 terminal numbers are functional; follow each part's wiring label.

g.text: 6. Bond to PE: drum, wells, jacket, stack, enclosure, junction box, SSR heat sink.

g.desc: 6. Bond to PE: drum, wells, jacket, stack, enclosure, junction box, SSR heat sink.

g.text: THERMOCOUPLES: T1, T3 to T6 on the ESP32; T2 on U2 only
